part1_calibration_error.note: Raw RMSE/MAE are in metric units (m, m/s) and are directly comparable between the two pairs. The dimensionless cost is normalised by each pair's OWN pooled spread (sigma_s = 4.97 m for HV-HV vs 11.18 m for HV-AV), so it ranks parameter vectors within a pair and must not be read as a cross-pair accuracy ranking.

sc2i_reference.label: SC2I run_1 (M5 differentiable IDM)
sc2i_reference.units: coordinate units (car length = 250 units), NOT metric

dimensionless_comparison.why: TGSIM is metric SI while the SC2I miniature testbed is in coordinate units (car length 250 units). Raw parameters are not comparable; these three combinations are invariant under a common rescaling of lengths and accelerations and are therefore the legitimate comparison.

part4s_spacing_convention.note: the alternative convention is a constant offset of the spacing; the calibrated vector re-scores with s0 shifted by the same offset, which is how the IDM absorbs a standstill-gap offset
